### GetRCIdentityRoot() {#ac5d623f0353e96c824196d6f6abc2dca}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">const Value * llvm::objcarc::GetRCIdentityRoot (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64promoteconstant-cpp/#a90f8350fecae261c25be85d38b451bff">const</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> * V)</td>
</tr>

</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel inline">inline</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The RCIdentity root of a value <span class="doxyComputerOutput">V</span> is a dominating value U for which retaining or releasing U is equivalent to retaining or releasing V.</p>


<p>In other words, ARC operations on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">V</span> are equivalent to ARC operations on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">U</span>.</p>


<p>We use this in the ARC optimizer to make it easier to match up ARC operations by always mapping ARC operations to RCIdentityRoots instead of pointers themselves.</p>


<p>The two ways that we see RCIdentical values in ObjC are via:</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>PointerCasts</li>
<li>Forwarding Calls that return their argument verbatim.</li>
</ol>

<p>Thus this function strips off pointer casts and forwarding calls. <em>NOTE</em> This implies that two RCIdentical values must alias.</p>


<p>Definition at line 110 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/objcarcanalysisutils-h">ObjCARCAnalysisUtils.h</a>.</p>


<p>References <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#ac4fc845f5ed92de63cd4474f128f5fc5">llvm::cast</a>, <a href="#a86cdbdf3773be3c67bc193b473b75708">GetBasicARCInstKind</a> and <a href="#a7137a432b1d5406783f79dd29fc591fb">IsForwarding</a>.</p>


<p>Referenced by <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/objcarc/objcarcaaresult/#acfba8e1035be99ff311c1af58e624878">llvm::objcarc::ObjCARCAAResult::alias</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/groups/arcopt/#gaa18296f3a634bc237e15fe2a5dd18820">collectReleaseInsertPts</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/groups/arcutilities/#gaf231df4dd6fb738c1f548aedb34ca81e">FindSingleUseIdentifiedObject</a>, <a href="#aa76bc27e7a62bc63263463a83525948f">GetArgRCIdentityRoot</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/objcarc/objcarcaaresult/#a846e0f39264857f2a44cbab95183b2a6">llvm::objcarc::ObjCARCAAResult::getModRefInfoMask</a>, <a href="#af0c2a3f45b5e3083ccb5561163fcdf20">GetRCIdentityRoot</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/utils/inlinefunction-cpp/#abf4fabc264b52dbd503f04805135a40e">inlineRetainOrClaimRVCalls</a> and <a href="#a509cccdade23eb44c7f84b31238dd52c">IsObjCIdentifiedObject</a>.</p>
